en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a sepia-toned photograph of a serene river landscape bordered by forested hills. The river is identified as 'Indalsälfven' near 'Sillre', both written in red print on the image. The border of the postcard is decorated with green ornate patterns. The reverse side is formatted for postal use in Swedish, including pre-printed text for address and stamp placement. Handwritten text in Swedish appears on both sides, with a visible date of 15 May 1903.
